p6_b4.ocr: A P-value of 0.1 implies that while there is some evidence of a discrepancy between groups, it may not reach conventional thresholds for statistical significance. Thus, the interplay between treatments and weight outcomes merits further investigation to elucidate the underlying mechanisms at work.
